approvals.usual: Deeggaraan {name} ofumaan faayiloota dubbisa, barbaada fi hojjeta; interneetii fayyadamuu, waa socholchuu, haquu ykn erguu dura si gaafata.

approvals.parent: Kana maatiin filate. Tokko jijjiiruuf isaan gaafadhu.
approvals.askText: Deeggaraan {name} waan hojjetu siif agarsiisee eega.
approvals.neverText: Deeggaraan {name} akka hin dandeenye fi maaliif akka ta'e sitti hima.
approvals.reserved: Jecha icciitii fi kaffaltii: ati qofa
approvals.covers.read: Faayiloota deeggaraa {name} kennite ykn inni hojjete dubbisuuf banuu
approvals.covers.edit: Faayilii haaraa barreessuu, ykn kan deeggaraan {name} hojjete ykn ati kennite jijjiiruu
approvals.covers.search: Interneetii ykn faayiloota kee keessatti waa barbaaduu
approvals.covers.execute: Sararoota koodii muraasaan waa sirriitti herreguu
approvals.covers.fetch: Fuula interneetii banuu, ykn marsariitii bira ga'uu
approvals.covers.move: Faayilii bakka biraa kaa'uu, ykn maqaa biraa itti moggaasuu
approvals.covers.other: Ergaa erguu, waa qooduu fi wanta tajaajiloota kee keessa hojjetamu kan biraa
approvals.covers.plan: Karoora tarkaanfiiwwan hedduu qabu itti fufuu
approvals.folders: Foldara deeggaraa {name} kennite keessatti, wanti asitti filatame maal iyyuu yoo ta'e, yeroo hunda jijjiirama siif agarsiisee dura si gaafata, foldara sanaaf Yeroo hunda hayyami yoo hin jenne malee.
approvals.exceptionsText: Waan kaardii irratti hayyamte fi waan of eeggannoo itti dabalte
approvals.allowedNone: Yeroo deeggaraan {name} gaafatu, Yeroo hunda hayyami deebii kee asitti kaa'a; yeroo barbaadde deebifachuu dandeessa.
approvals.carefulNone: Gosa hojii tokkoof ykn tajaajila tokkoof, dura gaafadhu ykn gonkumaa.
approvals.carefulText: Gosa hojii tokkoof ykn tajaajila tokkoof. Cimsa qofa: kan baratame caalaa gonkumaa hin hayyamu.
approvals.ifText: Deeggaraan {name} tokkoon tokkoon isaa dura kana of gaafata. Yoo beekuu dadhabe, akka eeyyeetti lakkaa'ama.
approvals.what.folder: Deeggaraan {name} utuu hin gaafatin foldara kana keessatti faayiloota jijjiira
approvals.what.films: Suuraa caalaa baasii qabaatanis utuu hin gaafatin hojjetamu
approvals.what.meeting: Deeggartoonni pirojektoota kanaa utuu hin gaafatin wal arguu danda'u
approvals.what.extension: Utuu si hin gaafatin hojiiwwan akka itti fufan hayyamuu danda'a
approvals.what.reads: Deeggaraan {name} utuu hin gaafatin achitti dubbisa
approvals.what.acts: Deeggaraan {name} utuu hin gaafatin achitti barreessa, erga, jijjiiras
approvals.elsewhere: Hojiin kun waan bakka biraa irraa dhufe, qajeelfama qabaachuu danda'u, dubbiseera; kanaaf irra deebi'amee si gaafatama.
